home.intro_text: Welcome to Khan Wahoud, a luxurious boutique hotel nestled within one of the last caravanserai that were built in the world, the meticulously restored walls of Khan Suleyman Pasha al-Azem in the heart of Old Damascus. Experience a harmonious blend of Ottoman grandeur, architectural authenticity, and modern comfort.
home.map_title: Located in the Heart of Historic Damascus
home.map_subtitle: Khan Suleyman Pasha is at the heart of the old city of Damascus, right on one of the most ancient and famous biblical streets, The Straight Street, Souk Midhat Pasha, that was built by the Romans, witnessed Paul the Apostle, and marks the passage of the famous Silk Road's caravans.

experience.title: The Khan Experience
experience.subtitle: Where History Meets Luxury
experience.history_text: Built in 1736, Khan Suleyman Pasha served as a vital commercial hub during the Ottoman era. Today, Khan Wahoud honors this legacy by preserving its architectural splendor while offering an unparalleled hospitality experience.
experience.restoration_text: Every stone and arch has been carefully restored using UNESCO-compliant methods and traditional Syrian craftsmanship, ensuring an authentic experience while meeting modern luxury standards.
experience.vip_text: Khan Wahoud is more than a hotel—it's a community of cultural enthusiasts, artists, and connoisseurs who appreciate our unique blend of heritage and luxury.

rooms.title: Rooms & Accommodation
rooms.subtitle: Ottoman Elegance, Modern Comfort
rooms.intro: Each room at Khan Wahoud tells its own story, blending Ottoman architectural elements with contemporary luxury. Choose your preferred sanctuary within our historic walls.

governors_suite.name: The Governor's Suite
governors_suite.description: Once the private quarters of visiting Ottoman officials, this spacious suite features original stone arches, a private courtyard, and premium amenities.
governors_suite.amenities: King bed, Private courtyard, Ottoman-style bath, Luxury linens, 24-hour concierge

merchants_quarters.name: The Merchant's Quarters
merchants_quarters.description: Inspired by the wealthy traders who once stayed in the Khan, these rooms feature authentic trading artifacts and luxurious furnishings.
merchants_quarters.amenities: Queen bed, Traditional seating area, Modern bathroom, Work desk, Evening tea service

minaret_view.name: The Minaret View Room
minaret_view.description: Offering stunning views of nearby minarets, these rooms capture the spiritual ambiance of Old Damascus.
minaret_view.amenities: Twin beds or Queen bed, Panoramic window, Traditional furnishings, En-suite bathroom

caravan_courtyard.name: Caravanserai Room
caravan_courtyard.description: Overlooking our central courtyard, these rooms echo the history of traveling merchant caravans with authentic design elements.
caravan_courtyard.amenities: Queen bed, Courtyard view, Handcrafted furniture, Rainfall shower

rooms.booking_info: Room rates include complimentary breakfast, evening cultural activities, and access to our Ottoman bath experience. Direct booking guarantees the best available rate.

dining.title: Food & Drink
dining.subtitle: Culinary Heritage Reimagined
dining.coming_soon_desc: A refined culinary journey celebrating Ottoman and Levantine gastronomic heritage is preparing to welcome guests in the historic courtyard of Khan Wahoud.
dining.intro: Our dining experiences will celebrate the rich culinary traditions of Damascus and the Levant region, crafted around one extraordinary historic courtyard.

courtyard.title: Courtyard Dining
courtyard.description: Dine under the open skies in our central courtyard, surrounded by centuries-old stone arches and the serene sounds of the central fountain.

private.title: Private Dining Chambers
private.description: Intimate historical chambers offering exclusive dining experiences and curated tasting menus for private gatherings.

chef.title: The Tea Lounge
chef.description: An intimate sanctuary for exquisite artisanal teas, traditional Damascene infusions, and handcrafted Ottoman sweets.

dining.inquire_text: Reservations will open soon. For private inquiries, previews, or event dining, please contact our concierge.

events.title: Private Events
events.subtitle: Timeless Celebrations in Historic Surroundings
events.intro: Host your special occasion in a venue that has witnessed centuries of gatherings. From intimate weddings to corporate retreats, Khan Wahoud provides an unparalleled setting.
events.wedding_text: Our courtyard transforms into a magical setting for ceremonies and celebrations, accommodating up to 120 guests.
events.corporate_text: Host meetings, retreats, or presentations in our fully-equipped heritage spaces, with customized catering and technical support.
events.cultural_text: Continue the Khan's legacy as a center for cultural exchange with readings, exhibitions, or musical performances.

membership.title: Be A Khan
membership.subtitle: Join Our Exclusive Community
membership.intro: Khan Wahoud membership offers access to exclusive experiences, events, and privileges while supporting our ongoing preservation efforts.
benefits: Priority room booking and preferential rates
Exclusive access to member-only events and cultural salons
Complimentary use of private dining chambers
membership.application_text: Membership is by invitation or application. Our committee reviews all applications with a focus on creating a diverse community of cultural enthusiasts.

restoration.title: Refurbishment & Preservation
restoration.subtitle: Honoring Heritage Through Restoration
restoration.intro: Our restoration project represents one of the most significant private heritage preservation initiatives in Syria, combining traditional craftsmanship with modern conservation techniques.
restoration.materials_text: Every element of the Khan was restored using authentic materials—from local stone quarried from the same historic sources to traditional mortar mixed according to Ottoman-era recipes.
restoration.sustainability_text: While preserving historical authenticity, we've integrated sustainable systems for water conservation, energy efficiency, and waste management.
restoration.video_subtitle: Watch a glimpse on our restoration technique
